configurations.name: E2E: All Tests (Choose local/dev)
configurations.command: cd e2e-tests && TARGET="${input:e2eTarget}"; if [ "$TARGET" = "local" ]; then export E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3010 E2E_USE_WEB_SERVER=true; else export E2E_BASE_URL=https://restaurant-order-system-blue.vercel.app E2E_USE_WEB_SERVER=false; fi; NODE_OPTIONS='' PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH" npm run test:all -- --reporter=line,html; TEST_EXIT=$?; NODE_OPTIONS='' PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH" npx playwright show-report || true; exit $TEST_EXIT
